concept: Code on an opaque code ground, set in the mono face, each syntax role in its own hue from the syntax tokens and at 4.5:1 or more on that ground, with a bar that names the code and keeps Copy in reach (D-040).

default_to_avoid.pattern: a code block on a grey ground with one colour, or a highlighter library that brings its own theme
default_to_avoid.kind: code block, code snippet, syntax highlighting, pre
default_to_avoid.why_not: a grey block hides the structure, and an outside theme ignores the tokens and the 4.5:1 floor

derivation.consequence: status is spoken in text as well as shown in colour
derivation.form: each syntax role takes its own hue at 4.5:1 or more on an opaque code ground, and the words still carry the code

derivation.consequence: keyboard reaches everything a pointer can, with a visible focus ring on any backdrop
derivation.form: Copy and Show all are buttons with 44px press areas, and the code is a focusable region

derivation.consequence: the scene supplies the hue; the system owns no hue of its own, only white at opacities and one ink, and colour appears only where it states a status or marks a diagram
derivation.form: the code ground is the one opaque surface in the pane, so the scene never changes how a role reads

derivation.consequence: light falls from above, so every surface carries a rim brightest along its top edge and a soft shadow below that says where it floats, and a recess is the inverse, shaded under its top lip and lit on its bottom lip; a nested surface adds no second blur, because one sheet of glass is one layer
derivation.form: the block nests in the pane like an inner surface, framed by a hairline

options: A opaque code ground, roles in colour
B code on the glass, roles in colour
variants.reason: B lets the scene change every role's contrast, and C hides the structure; A measures every role against one known ground

root.why: an opaque code ground so every role is measured against one known colour

bar.why: the label and the actions sit above the code, parted by a hairline

label.why: says what the code is, in small caps like other labels

actions.why: Show all and Copy side by side at the bar's end

action.why: a quiet text button with a 44px press area

code.why: the mono face at caption size and body leading, scrolling sideways instead of wrapping

clipped.why: a long block fades out at its foot to say there is more

numbered.why: line numbers count from one in the gutter

line.why: each numbered line carries its number in the comment colour, outside the selection

hidden.why: says Copied to a screen reader when the copy has worked, without showing a second word

hover.why: an action answers the pointer with the quiet surface

focus-visible.why: the focus ring is drawn inside so the block's corner never clips it

@media forced-colors: active.why: in forced colours every role takes the system text colour and the block keeps an outline

data-syntax.why: each run of the code carries its role, and each role takes its own hue from the syntax tokens at 4.5:1 or more

data-syntax=comment.why: comments read in their own colour and in italic, quiet beside the code

data-syntax=keyword.why: keywords take their own hue so the shape of the code shows at a glance

data-syntax=string.why: strings take their own hue so values stand apart from names

data-syntax=number.why: numbers and colours take their own hue so values stand apart from names

data-syntax=function.why: calls take their own hue so what runs stands apart from what is read

data-syntax=type.why: components and types take their own hue so the parts of a screen stand out

data-syntax=tag.why: tags and selectors take their own hue so structure reads before detail

data-syntax=attr.why: attributes and flags take their own hue so options read apart from their values

data-syntax=property.why: properties and keys take their own hue so each setting is found by name

data-syntax=punctuation.why: punctuation stays quiet so the words carry the code

background-color.why: the action's hover fades over the hover duration
